facts.fact: The joint UPR submission treats the Computer Misuse Act, Cap 96 as existing law, citing the Computer Misuse (Amendment) Act, 2022 and a March 2026 Constitutional Court decision on it, and urges repeal or amendment of sections 24 and 25.

note: Says sections 24 and 25 have been used against expression, undated and with no case named, so no use fact.
